# Git & GitHub Crash Course

![Course roadmap: 0 Setup, 1 First commit, 2 Branch & PR, 3 Merge conflicts, 4 Rebase](assets/hero.svg)

A hands-on Git and GitHub crash course. You'll work in **your own copy** of this repository and
finish four exercises, from your very first commit up to resolving merge conflicts and rebasing.

<!-- PROGRESS -->

> **This page shows one exercise at a time.** When you finish one, GitHub Actions replaces this
> page with the next exercise. It takes about 30 seconds, then refresh.
